COMPLETE
  ✓ Empty queue emits a normal-state line without peek queue head failed; real peek failures retain the error-shaped log; focused cron tests pass.: All three clauses verified by execution. (1) Empty queue: internal/cron/loop.go:604-611 — `head, err := l.cfg.Queue.PeekPending(ctx)`; the error branch logs 'peek queue head failed', while `if head == nil { return }` returns silently with no log. A probe test (empty fakeQueue + tripped load gate) produced log output "cron: deferred — host busy (load): used 1.000 / threshold 0.500
" ONLY — no 'peek queue head failed' line. (2) Real peek failure: a probe with a PeekPending override returning errors.New("db is locked") produced "cron: deferral stamp: peek queue head failed: db is locked (continuing)
cron: deferred — host busy (load): used 1.000 / threshold 0.500
" — the error-shaped log is retained. (3) Focused cron tests: `go test ./internal/cron/ -count=1 -run 'Deferral|Gate' -v` -> TestTickGateDeferralStampsQueueHead PASS, TestTickGateDeferralMemoryLine PASS, TestRunGateDeferralIsNotATickError PASS, TestTickGateOpenReclaimsAndSolves PASS, TestTickGateDeferral_RealQueuePersistence PASS, TestCheckIdleMemoryGateTrips PASS, 'ok github.com/totalwindupflightsystems/off-by-one/internal/cron 0.007s'. Full package `go test ./internal/cron/ -count=1` -> 'ok ... 0.115s'; `go build ./...` clean; `go vet ./internal/cron/` exit 0. Note: the behavior was already correct before this task (loop.go last modified by 895c0861, DF-OFF-BY-ONE-45; the task's diff contains only .gitreins/tasks.yaml metadata), and no committed regression test pins either branch (grep 'peek queue head failed' in *_test.go returns 0 matches; fakeQueue.PeekPending at loop_test.go:96 cannot return an error) — but the criterion's stated behaviors and the focused-test requirement all hold.
Empty queue emits only the normal deferral line while real PeekPending errors keep the 'peek queue head failed' log, and all focused cron tests pass (ok 0.115s, build/vet clean).
